Here's the full read-out on **Fernwood Skin Co**:

---

### ✅ Qualified Consumer Brand — Recommend Outreach

| Dimension | Score | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Retail Hiring** | 28 / 30 | Director of Retail explicitly owns site selection, pop-up tests in regional malls, and 2027 store openings — top of the band |
| **Physical Stage** | 14 / 20 | Actively scoping mall pop-ups; first three branded stores named for 2027 |
| **Category Fit** | 9 / 10 | Clean skincare is a top mall performer — high basket, gifting, strong sampling loop |

---

### Why Act Now
The SEC Form D shows ~$6.2M just closed (first sale **Aug 30, 2026**), and the Director of Retail job dropped **Oct 18** — they are in the *exact* window between "funding secured" and "first real estate decisions made." That new Director will need a pop-up venue within weeks of starting, and your pitch gets in before their list is set.

### Sales Rep Pitch Angle
> *Your incoming Director of Retail is explicitly scoped to run pop-up tests in regional malls before committing to permanent leases in 2027 — our network is the fastest path to that proof-of-concept, offering concourse pop-ups and kiosks in high-traffic centers that over-index on the same clean-beauty shopper already buying Fernwood at Ulta. We can compress your site-selection timeline by delivering real foot-traffic, dwell, and conversion data across multiple markets within a single lease cycle. Layer in digital directory placements and experiential activations to build brand heat and drive trial at scale, giving your new retail leader a turnkey playbook to present at your first store-opening decision.*

### Recommended Formats (priority order)
1. **Concourse Pop-ups** — directly named in their job listing as the testing vehicle
2. **Pop-Up Kiosks** — lower-commitment entry point to unlock multiple markets simultaneously
3. **Experiential Activations** — skincare sampling/skin-analysis experiences convert browsers to buyers and generate social content
